description_en: Identifies specific elements in e-commerce images. It analyzes image details to help users quickly identify elements such as text, logos, watermarks, and text-containing color blocks in the main subject and background, significantly improving the efficiency and accuracy of image filtering
description_zh: 智能元素识别API是专为电商图像特定元素识别而设计的API。它能够深入挖掘图像中的细节，帮助用户快速识别图片主体和背景中的文字、Logo、水印及含字色块等元素，能极大提升图像筛选的效率和准确性
name: ImageRecognitionAsync

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format. The resolution must be between 256 × 256 and 3000 × 3000 pixels, and the file size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 图片URL，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至3000x3000像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the types of elements to be detected on the image subject. Valid values:
1: Watermark.
2: Logo.
3: Text.
4: Text-containing color block.
You can specify multiple element types
parameters.help_zh: 检测图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），元素类型可多选
parameters.name: object_detect_elements

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the types of elements to be detected outside the image subject. Valid values:
1: Watermark.
2: Logo.
3: Text.
4: Text-containing color block.
You can specify multiple element types. This parameter and ObjectDetectElements cannot be empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 检测非图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），元素类型可多选，与objectDetectElements不可同时为空
parameters.name: non_object_detect_elements

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the OCR results of the text in the recognized area. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回识别区域文字OCR结果（1是，0否），不传默认为0
parameters.name: return_character

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the marginalization distance of the subject. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回主体边缘化距离（1是，0否），不传默认为0
parameters.name: return_border_pixel

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the area proportion of the subject. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回主体面积占比（1是，0否），不传默认为0
parameters.name: return_product_prop

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the number of subjects. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回主体数量（1是，0否），不传默认为0
parameters.name: return_product_num

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the text proportion. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No.
Default value: 0.
This parameter takes effect only when the following two conditions are met:
ReturnCharacter is set to 1.
ObjectDetectElements or NonObjectDetectElements is set to 3, which means text recognition is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回文字占比比例（1是，0否），不传默认为0。
该字段需满足两个条件才生效：
returnCharacter需同时传1；
objectDetectElements或nonObjectDetectElements其中一个字段需要设置3（即需要识别文字）
parameters.name: return_character_prop

Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时不会返回该参数。

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 是否成功：true 代表成功，false 代表失败
